findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rbi_supervisory_tape, corporate_transmission_board, household_credit_board, crypto_regime_board · Private data: evidence_markets, evidence_europe, universe_search, verify_published_record · Public sink: forward_odds · Destructive: stablecoin_rails_board, crypto_exposure_board.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rbi_supervisory_tape, corporate_transmission_board, household_credit_board, crypto_regime_board · Private data: evidence_markets, evidence_europe, universe_search, verify_published_record · Public sink: forward_odds · Destructive: stablecoin_rails_board, crypto_exposure_board

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
